hypothesis_en: Engineering-only coverage response-order experiment: ask the existing explanation paragraph and whole-notice comparison before choosing loss IDs, then emit the unchanged remaining fields. Previous actual coverage replies emit loss IDs before explaining the comparison and invent a category obligation or provider loss despite the existing exception; a prior order diagnostic proposed but never applied this experiment. The new semantic screen again has correct main decisions followed by those false coverage vetoes. All retention-policy paragraphs, main prompts/rubric, field names/types/enums, schema, validator, quoted evidence, critic veto authority, source presentation, model and sampling stay unchanged. This observation is not proof of causality: verify actual emitted order and native validity, then compare hard screens and separate cookie controls. Reject if order is ignored or technical validity worsens; do not repeat failed groups to select a lucky sample.
hypothesis_zh: 仅对coverage回复顺序进行工程实验：要求先生成既有explanation段落并完成全篇比较，再选择损失ID，之后输出不变的其余字段。既往真实coverage回复先给损失ID再解释比较，尽管存在例外仍推断类别义务或服务商损失；此前顺序诊断提出但未实际实施过这一实验。新的语义筛查再次出现main判断正确后被coverage误否决。全部保留政策段落、main提示词与rubric、字段名类型枚举、schema、校验器、引用证据、critic只能否决的权限、原文呈现、模型及采样均不变。该观察不证明因果：须核验实际输出顺序及原生有效性，再比较硬回归与单独cookie反例。若顺序未生效或技术有效性退步则淘汰，不重复失败组以挑选幸运样本。
